$comment: The layout pieces install.sh adds, for adding them by hand to a personal layout (never to a shipped one: clone it first, herdr-app do layout.clone '{"name":"main","as":"my-layout"}'). Take each value, not this wrapper.

panel_in_stack.$where: append to the children of the right-hand stack `panel-body` (Herdr's main layout and its clones); its parent column `panel` is what shows and hides

panel_column.$where: only when the layout has no `panel-body` stack: insert into the row that holds the tab block, right after it; then set ui.panel to {"column": "ledgr-panel", "stack": null, "child": "ledgr"} in ledgr-data/config.json

host_beside_status.$where: replace the `status` block with this row, moving the status block's `size` onto the row; the first child is the status block as it was

host_floating.$where: append to the `floating` list of the tab block (the block whose content is {"tab": "active"})

chip_pane_header.$where: the tab block's content.pane.header; with no pane frame yet, add "pane": {"header": ...}
